title: The Council
description: One question, four answers. Four quests below wait on the same three trials, and
each one uses a different rule for how many of them it needs: all started, any one
completed, any two of the three, and the rule the chapter itself declares.
Side by side they are the clearest way to see what a prerequisite mode is. The same
three arrows arrive at each of them, and the four nodes disagree about what counts
as enough -- which is how 'all_completed' stops being an incantation and becomes a
One node here leans on another group entirely, and it is deliberately the only edge
in the whole collection that does: a dependency may name a quest in another
